retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s-style collage featuring a monochrome photographic subject integrated with vibrant airbrushed pastel backgrounds and dynamic, overlapping script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central monochrome photographic cutout of a woman on a vintage scooter, set against a split-tone airbrushed background of teal and lavender, overlaid with large-scale, expressive script lettering that interacts with the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. high-saturation pastel background
Dynamic script lettering overlapping the central figure
Airbrushed texture softening the transition between color blocks
Diagonal composition of the scooter creating movement
coreInvariants: Grainy monochrome photographic texture for the central figure
Soft airbrushed stipple effect in the background gradients
Thin-stroke, high-contrast script typography with drop shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure, slightly off-center, occupying 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white vintage scooter body and the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal flow from the top-left (face) down through the scooter's body to the bottom-right wheel.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the top-right and bottom-left corners, filled with airbrushed color.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and Lavender airbrushed background blocks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Monochrome grayscale for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the typography and scooter highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value pastels with medium saturation contrasted against neutral grays.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with elongated ascenders and descenders.
letterConstructionRules: Large, sweeping loops for capital letters
Connected lowercase letters with sharp angles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated 'C' and 'R' that frame the central subject
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script style used for all display text to maintain 80s aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thin, personal, and dynamic flow of the lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed background with a teal left side and a lavender right side, featuring a grainy stipple texture. Place a monochrome, grainy photographic cutout of a woman on a white vintage scooter in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, thin-stroke white script lettering diagonally across the center, ensuring it overlaps the subject with a subtle dark drop shadow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the background airbrushed with a stipple texture?
Does the script lettering have large, sweeping loops?
Is there a clear teal and lavender color split?

mustRedesign: Any modern digital gradients (must be airbrushed/stippled)

mustAchieve: Dynamic interaction between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for stipple texture in background
Verify script overlaps the subject correctly
Ensure monochrome subject contrast is high
Confirm the teal/lavender split is soft-edged
Check that text is legible despite the overlap
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome subject + Airbrushed pastel split background + Overlapping thin script = 80s Pop Aesthetic
